transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. What do you need?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. I'm calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. As of today, I see there is a minimum payment of Rs 4,820 that was due on 2026-10-15 and has not been received yet.

May I ask if you have already made this payment, or would you be able to make it soon?
I haven’t made the payment yet because of that late fee. I want the late fee waived first. Other banks have done that for me before. Can you waive it?

Thank you for letting me know, Mr. Sharma. I understand your concern about the late fee. I do not have the authority to approve or negotiate any waiver or reduction of fees. However, I will note your request, and a human agent from Mumbai Bank will get in touch with you to discuss this further.

Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your pending payment, or would you like to request a call back at a specific time?

I really want to pay, but only if that late fee is dropped. Can’t you just put me through to someone who can authorize it? Other banks have waived fees just like this for me. I’m ready to pay right now if the fee is removed.
